title: Issue 004 · Morning — The leverage of one
description: Morning edition for Tuesday, November 24, 2026. The big idea: the leverage of one. In this episode: It only takes an individual; The agents were mostly waiting; Relief rally, and a $44 billion bet on security; Fraud moved to the front door; The $35 turkey; Amdahl's law, for product people; Measure behavior, not output; Briefly noted; and Pick a deep dive.
